Questions

What does “Residential complexes, business centres and bazaars” cost?
The MVP costs $12,000–25,000 (UZS 144–305 mln), the full version $35,000–80,000 (UZS 420–965 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Residential complexes, business centres and bazaars” take?
The MVP takes 8–12 weeks, the full version 16–28 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
How the work runs today and sample documents; existing data: Excel or an old system; staff to try the system; one person who makes the decisions.
